activity.notes: Muhammad Shaybani captured Bukhara in 1500 and founded the Abu'l-Khayrid/Shibanid Uzbek state in Transoxiana. Iranica treats him as ruler in 1500-1510; he was killed at Merv on 2 December 1510.

sources.title: ABU'L-KHAYRIDS — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Iranica identifies Muhammad Shaybani as ruler from 1500 to 1510 and as founder of the Uzbek state that became the Khanate of Bukhara.

sources.title: BUKHARA iii. After the Mongol Invasion — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Iranica records Shaybani Khan's capture of Bukhara after a three-day siege in 1500.
